phaeacian.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the Phaeacians, a fabulous seafaring
   people fond of the feast, the lyre, and the dance, mentioned by Homer.
phaeacian.translation: n. [希神]费阿刻斯人(荷马史诗 Odysseus 中居住在 Scheria 岛的一个民族,以航海为生)

phaedrus.translation: n. 斐德罗篇（书名）；菲德拉斯（一世纪罗马寓言作家）

phaenogam.definition: n. Any plant of the class Phaenogamia.

phaenogamous.definition:
a. Having true flowers with with distinct floral organs;
   flowering.

phaeophyceae.definition: n brown algae; mostly marine and littoral eukaryotic algae

phaeophyta.definition: n coextensive with class Phaeophyceae; in some classifications subsumed in the division Heterokontophyta

phaeospore.definition:
n. A brownish zoospore, characteristic of an order
   (Phaeosporeae) of dark green or olive-colored algae.

phaethon.definition:
n. The son of Helios (Phoebus), that is, the son of light,
   or of the sun. He is fabled to have obtained permission to drive the
   chariot of the sun, in doing which his want of skill would have set the
   world on fire, had he not been struck with a thunderbolt by Jupiter,
   and hurled headlong into the river Po.
n. A genus of oceanic birds including the tropic birds.

phaethontidae.translation: [网络] 鹲科；鸏科；热带鸟科

phaeton.definition: n large open car seating four with folding top
phaeton.translation: n. 一种轻快的四轮马车

phaetons.definition:
plural of phaeton
n large open car seating four with folding top
phaetons.translation: (phaeton 的复数) n.一种轻快的四轮马车
